name: Orbital Nexus
detailed_description:
🌌 Endless Space, Infinite Possibilities – Rule the Galaxy Your Way!

In this deep and open-ended space construction strategy game, you start as a lone colony and expand across the stars. Explore unknown planets, exploit rare resources, build a vast industrial empire, command mighty fleets, interact with enigmatic alien relics, and ultimately become the supreme ruler—or destroyer—of the galaxy.

🪐 Planetary Colonization & Urban Development

  • Diverse Worlds: Each planet offers unique environments and resources. Adapt your strategy to build industrial hubs, research centers, military fortresses, or trade nexuses, optimizing your production chains.

  • Space Station Empire: Construct refineries, shipyards, research labs, and more in orbit, creating a seamless interstellar logistics network.

  • Megastructures of Legend: Recover lost technology fragments scattered across the cosmos to construct superstructures that grant game-changing bonuses!

⚔️ Warfare & Diplomacy Among the Stars

  • Fleet Customization & Conquest: Design warships ranging from nimble scouts to colossal titans, then wage war to seize enemy worlds—or forge uneasy alliances through diplomacy.

  • Mysteries of the Ancients: Three distinct alien relics may appear, offering rare technologies, elite warships, or unique station modules in exchange for tribute… but each choice carries hidden risks.

🔮 Deep Strategy & Dynamic Events

  • Resource Management & Crisis Survival: Balance energy, minerals, food, and population while facing pirate raids, black hole anomalies, alien plagues, and more—will your empire thrive or collapse?

  • Multiple Paths to Victory: Achieve military domination, unlock a scientific transcendence, or even discover a secret ending—your choices shape the galaxy’s fate.

🚀 Begin Your Journey Today—The Stars Await Your Command!

short_description: Start on a barren planet, expand your empire through resource management, fleet building, and planetary conquest. Discover cosmic relics, trade or fight with neutral factions, and build galactic wonders like particle colliders. Balance strategy, exploration, and combat to dominate the galaxy!
